summary: Healthcare delivery in resource-constrained environments is improved by OpenMRS, a patient-based medical record system providing a free, customizable electronic medical record system for providers. The mission is to coordinate a global community creating a robust, scalable, user-driven, open-source medical record system platform. This platform benefits healthcare providers and patients in developing countries, addressing health sector challenges. OpenMRS operates in low-income countries and resource-constrained environments, focusing on improving healthcare delivery. The project's impact is to enhance healthcare access and quality, particularly in underserved communities.
